<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Snake</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{background:#0f110f;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;height:100vh;overflow:hidden}
canvas{display:block;cursor:default}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const C=20,R=24,SZ=20,W=C*SZ,H=R*SZ;
const cv=document.getElementById('c');
cv.width=W;cv.height=H;
const cx=cv.getContext('2d');

let snake,dir,ndir,food,score,best=0,state,timer,spd;

function init(){
  const m=Math.floor(R/2);
  snake=[{x:Math.floor(C/2),y:m},{x:Math.floor(C/2)-1,y:m},{x:Math.floor(C/2)-2,y:m}];
  dir={x:1,y:0};ndir={x:1,y:0};
  score=0;spd=110;state='play';
  placeFood();
}

function placeFood(){
  let p;
  do{p={x:Math.floor(Math.random()*C),y:Math.floor(Math.random()*R)}}
  while(snake.some(s=>s.x===p.x&&s.y===p.y));
  food=p;
}

function step(){
  dir=ndir;
  const h={x:snake[0].x+dir.x,y:snake[0].y+dir.y};
  if(h.x<0||h.x>=C||h.y<0||h.y>=R||snake.some(s=>s.x===h.x&&s.y===h.y)){
    state='dead';best=Math.max(best,score);return;
  }
  snake.unshift(h);
  if(h.x===food.x&&h.y===food.y){
    score+=10;placeFood();
    if(spd>55)spd-=2;
  }else{snake.pop()}
}

function draw(){
  cx.fillStyle='#0f110f';cx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  // grid dots
  cx.fillStyle='#1a1d1a';
  for(let i=0;i<C;i++)for(let j=0;j<R;j++)
    cx.fillRect(i*SZ+SZ/2,j*SZ+SZ/2,1,1);

  // food glow
  const fx=food.x*SZ+SZ/2,fy=food.y*SZ+SZ/2;
  const g=cx.createRadialGradient(fx,fy,2,fx,fy,SZ);
  g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(231,76,60,0.25)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(231,76,60,0)');
  cx.fillStyle=g;cx.fillRect(fx-SZ,fy-SZ,SZ*2,SZ*2);

  // food
  cx.fillStyle='#e74c3c';
  cx.beginPath();cx.arc(fx,fy,SZ/2-3,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

  // snake
  snake.forEach((s,i)=>{
    const t=i/snake.length;
    const r=Math.round(46+t*10),gr=Math.round(204-t*80),b=Math.round(113-t*50);
    cx.fillStyle=`rgb(${r},${gr},${b})`;
    const pad=i===0?1:2,rad=i===0?5:3;
    roundRect(s.x*SZ+pad,s.y*SZ+pad,SZ-pad*2,SZ-pad*2,rad);
  });

  // eyes on head
  const h=snake[0];
  cx.fillStyle='#0f110f';
  const ex=h.x*SZ+SZ/2,ey=h.y*SZ+SZ/2;
  const ox=dir.x*3,oy=dir.y*3;
  cx.beginPath();cx.arc(ex-3+ox,ey-3+oy,2,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
  cx.beginPath();cx.arc(ex+3+ox,ey-3+oy,2,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

  // score
  cx.fillStyle='#c8d6c8';cx.font='bold 14px monospace';cx.textAlign='left';
  cx.fillText('SCORE '+score,8,18);
  cx.textAlign='right';
  cx.fillText('BEST '+best,W-8,18);

  if(state==='dead'){
    cx.fillStyle='rgba(15,17,15,0.75)';cx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    cx.fillStyle='#e74c3c';cx.font='bold 28px monospace';cx.textAlign='center';
    cx.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2,H/2-20);
    cx.fillStyle='#c8d6c8';cx.font='14px monospace';
    cx.fillText('Score: '+score,W/2,H/2+14);
    cx.fillStyle='#7a8a7a';cx.font='12px monospace';
    cx.fillText('Press any key to restart',W/2,H/2+40);
  }

  if(state==='start'){
    cx.fillStyle='rgba(15,17,15,0.8)';cx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    cx.fillStyle='#2ecc71';cx.font='bold 32px monospace';cx.textAlign='center';
    cx.fillText('SNAKE',W/2,H/2-20);
    cx.fillStyle='#7a8a7a';cx.font='12px monospace';
    cx.fillText('Press any key to start',W/2,H/2+20);
  }
}

function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r){
  cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(x+r,y);cx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);cx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r);
  cx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);cx.quadraticCurveTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h);
  cx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);cx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r);
  cx.lineTo(x,y+r);cx.quadraticCurveTo(x,y,x+r,y);cx.fill();
}

function loop(){
  if(state==='play')step();
  draw();
  timer=setTimeout(loop,state==='play'?spd:200);
}

function key(e){
  const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
  if(state==='start'){init();return}
  if(state==='dead'){init();return}
  const map={
    arrowup:{x:0,y:-1},arrowdown:{x:0,y:1},arrowleft:{x:-1,y:0},arrowright:{x:1,y:0},
    w:{x:0,y:-1},s:{x:0,y:1},a:{x:-1,y:0},d:{x:1,y:0}
  };
  const nd=map[k]||map[e.key];
  if(nd&&(nd.x+dir.x!==0||nd.y+dir.y!==0)){ndir=nd;e.preventDefault()}
}

state='start';snake=[{x:12,y:12},{x:11,y:12},{x:10,y:12}];dir={x:1,y:0};ndir={x:1,y:0};food={x:18,y:12};score=0;
draw();timer=setTimeout(loop,200);
document.addEventListener('keydown',key);
cv.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(state!=='play')init()});
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Snake</title>
<style>
    body { margin: 0; height: 100vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #111; font-family: sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { background: #222; box-shadow: 0 0 20px #000; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const c = document.getElementById('c');
const x = c.getContext('2d');
const T = 20;
const S = 24;
let snake, food, dx, dy, score, loop, over, start;
let ip = false;

function init() {
    snake = [{x:12,y:12},{x:11,y:12},{x:10,y:12}];
    dx = 1; dy = 0;
    score = 0;
    over = false;
    start = true;
    placeFood();
    draw();
}

function placeFood() {
    let valid = false;
    while(!valid) {
        food = {x: Math.floor(Math.random()*S), y: Math.floor(Math.random()*S)};
        valid = !snake.some(s => s.x === food.x && s.y === food.y);
    }
}

function update() {
    if(start || over) return;
    ip = false;
    const h = {x: snake[0].x + dx, y: snake[0].y + dy};
    if(h.x < 0 || h.x >= S || h.y < 0 || h.y >= S || snake.some(s => s.x === h.x && s.y === h.y)) {
        over = true; draw(); return;
    }
    snake.unshift(h);
    if(h.x === food.x && h.y === food.y) { score += 10; placeFood(); }
    else { snake.pop(); }
    draw();
}

function draw() {
    x.fillStyle = '#222'; x.fillRect(0,0,480,480);
    x.fillStyle = '#ff4757'; x.fillRect(food.x*T+2, food.y*T+2, T-4, T-4);
    x.fillStyle = '#2ed573'; 
    snake.forEach(s => x.fillRect(s.x*T+2, s.y*T+2, T-4, T-4));
    x.fillStyle = '#fff'; x.font = '16px sans-serif'; x.fillText('Score: '+score, 10, 24);
    if(start) {
        x.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)'; x.fillRect(0,0,480,480);
        x.fillStyle = '#fff'; x.font = 'bold 30px sans-serif'; x.textAlign = 'center';
        x.fillText('CLICK TO START', 240, 240);
    }
    if(over) {
        x.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)'; x.fillRect(0,0,480,480);
        x.fillStyle = '#fff'; x.font = 'bold 40px sans-serif'; x.textAlign = 'center';
        x.fillText('GAME OVER', 240, 220);
        x.font = '20px sans-serif'; x.fillText('Score: '+score, 240, 260);
        x.font = '16px sans-serif'; x.fillText('Click to Restart', 240, 300);
    }
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if(start || over) return;
    if(ip) return;
    const k = e.key;
    if((k==='ArrowUp'||k==='w'||k==='W') && dy!==1) { dx=0; dy=-1; }
    else if((k==='ArrowDown'||k==='s'||k==='S') && dy!==-1) { dx=0; dy=1; }
    else if((k==='ArrowLeft'||k==='a'||k==='A') && dx!==1) { dx=-1; dy=0; }
    else if((k==='ArrowRight'||k==='d'||k==='D') && dx!==-1) { dx=1; dy=0; }
    ip = true;
});

c.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if(over || start) {
        if(loop) clearInterval(loop);
        init();
        start = false;
        loop = setInterval(update, 100);
    }
});

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    <title>Flappy Square</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            background: #222;
            font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
            overflow: hidden;
            user-select: none;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }
        #gameCanvas {
            background: #70c5ce;
            border: 4px solid #fff;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            cursor: pointer;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="480" height="480"></canvas>

    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        // Game Constants
        const GRAVITY = 0.25;
        const JUMP = -5;
        const PIPE_SPEED = 2.5;
        const PIPE_SPAWN_RATE = 90; // frames
        const PIPE_WIDTH = 60;
        const PIPE_GAP = 140;
        const BIRD_SIZE = 24;

        // Game State
        let bird = { x: 80, y: 240, v: 0 };
        let pipes = [];
        let score = 0;
        let frame = 0;
        let state = 'START'; // START, PLAYING, GAMEOVER

        function reset() {
            bird = { x: 80, y: 240, v: 0 };
            pipes = [];
            score = 0;
            frame = 0;
            state = 'PLAYING';
        }

        function jump() {
            if (state === 'START') {
                reset();
            } else if (state === 'PLAYING') {
                bird.v = JUMP;
            } else if (state === 'GAMEOVER') {
                reset();
            }
        }

        window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.code === 'Space') jump(); });
        canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', jump);
        canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); jump(); });

        function update() {
            if (state !== 'PLAYING') return;

            frame++;
            bird.v += GRAVITY;
            bird.y += bird.v;

            // Floor/Ceiling collision
            if (bird.y + BIRD_SIZE/2 > canvas.height || bird.y - BIRD_SIZE/2 < 0) {
                state = 'GAMEOVER';
            }

            // Pipe generation
            if (frame % PIPE_SPAWN_RATE === 0) {
                const minPipeHeight = 50;
                const maxPipeHeight = canvas.height - PIPE_GAP - minPipeHeight;
                const height = Math.floor(Math.random() * (maxPipeHeight - minPipeHeight + 1)) + minPipeHeight;
                pipes.push({ x: canvas.width, top: height, passed: false });
            }

            // Pipe movement and collision
            for (let i = pipes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                let p = pipes[i];
                p.x -= PIPE_SPEED;

                // Collision check
                if (bird.x + BIRD_SIZE/2 > p.x && bird.x - BIRD_SIZE/2 < p.x + PIPE_WIDTH) {
                    if (bird.y - BIRD_SIZE/2 < p.top || bird.y + BIRD_SIZE/2 > p.top + PIPE_GAP) {
                        state = 'GAMEOVER';
                    }
                }

                // Score update
                if (!p.passed && p.x + PIPE_WIDTH < bird.x) {
                    score++;
                    p.passed = true;
                }

                // Cleanup
                if (p.x + PIPE_WIDTH < 0) pipes.splice(i, 1);
            }
        }

        function draw() {
            // Background
            ctx.fillStyle = '#70c5ce';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

            // Pipes
            ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
            pipes.forEach(p => {
                // Top pipe
                ctx.fillRect(p.x, 0, PIPE_WIDTH, p.top);
                ctx.strokeStyle = '#27ae60';
                ctx.lineWidth = 4;
                ctx.strokeRect(p.x, 0, PIPE_WIDTH, p.top);
                
                // Bottom pipe
                ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.top + PIPE_GAP, PIPE_WIDTH, canvas.height - (p.top + PIPE_GAP));
                ctx.strokeRect(p.x, p.top + PIPE_GAP, PIPE_WIDTH, canvas.height - (p.top + PIPE_GAP));
            });

            // Bird
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(bird.x, bird.y);
            ctx.rotate(Math.min(Math.PI/4, Math.max(-Math.PI/4, bird.v * 0.1)));
            ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
            ctx.fillRect(-BIRD_SIZE/2, -BIRD_SIZE/2, BIRD_SIZE, BIRD_SIZE);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#000';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(-BIRD_SIZE/2, -BIRD_SIZE/2, BIRD_SIZE, BIRD_SIZE);
            ctx.restore();

            // UI
            ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'black';
            ctx.lineWidth = 4;
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';

            if (state === 'START') {
                ctx.font = 'bold 32px system-ui';
                ctx.strokeText('FLAPPY SQUARE', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 - 20);
                ctx.fillText('FLAPPY SQUARE', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 - 20);
                ctx.font = '20px system-ui';
                ctx.strokeText('CLICK or SPACE to START', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 30);
                ctx.fillText('CLICK or SPACE to START', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 30);
            } else if (state === 'PLAYING') {
                ctx.font = 'bold 48px system-ui';
                ctx.strokeText(score, canvas.width/2, 60);
                ctx.fillText(score, canvas.width/2, 60);
            } else if (state === 'GAMEOVER') {
                ctx.font = 'bold 48px system-ui';
                ctx.strokeText('GAME OVER', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 - 40);
                ctx.fillText('GAME OVER', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 - 40);
                ctx.font = 'bold 32px system-ui';
                ctx.strokeText(`SCORE: ${score}`, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 10);
                ctx.fillText(`SCORE: ${score}`, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 10);
                ctx.font = '20px system-ui';
                ctx.strokeText('CLICK to RESTART', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 60);
                ctx.fillText('CLICK to RESTART', canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2 + 60);
            }
        }

        function loop() {
            update();
            draw();
            requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }

        loop();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{width:480px;height:480px;overflow:hidden;background:#1a1a2e}
canvas{display:block;cursor:pointer}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const c=document.getElementById('c'),x=c.getContext('2d'),W=480,H=480;
const G=0.42,FLAP=-7.2,PIPE_W=52,GAP=130,PIPE_SPD=2.4,PIPE_INT=95;
let bird,pipes,score,best=0,state,frameCount,ground;

function init(){
  bird={x:100,y:H/2,vy:0,r:12,rot:0};
  pipes=[];score=0;frameCount=0;
  ground=0;state='ready';
}

function flap(){
  if(state==='ready'){state='play';bird.vy=FLAP;}
  else if(state==='play')bird.vy=FLAP;
  else if(state==='dead'&&frameCount>30)init();
}

function addPipe(){
  let minTop=60,maxTop=H-GAP-80;
  let top=minTop+Math.random()*(maxTop-minTop);
  pipes.push({x:W,top,bot:top+GAP,scored:false});
}

function update(){
  if(state!=='play')return;
  bird.vy+=G;
  bird.y+=bird.vy;
  bird.rot=Math.min(Math.max(bird.vy*3,-30),70);

  if(frameCount%PIPE_INT===0)addPipe();

  for(let i=pipes.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    let p=pipes[i];
    p.x-=PIPE_SPD;
    if(!p.scored&&p.x+PIPE_W<bird.x){p.scored=true;score++;}
    if(p.x<-PIPE_W)pipes.splice(i,1);
  }

  ground=(ground+PIPE_SPD)%24;

  // collision
  let bx=bird.x,by=bird.y,br=bird.r;
  if(by+br>H-40||by-br<0){die();return;}
  for(let p of pipes){
    if(bx+br>p.x&&bx-br<p.x+PIPE_W){
      if(by-br<p.top||by+br>p.bot){die();return;}
    }
  }
}

function die(){
  state='dead';frameCount=0;
  if(score>best)best=score;
}

function drawBG(){
  // sky gradient
  let g=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H-40);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#16213e');
  g.addColorStop(0.5,'#1a1a2e');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#0f3460');
  x.fillStyle=g;x.fillRect(0,0,W,H-40);

  // stars
  x.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.15)';
  for(let i=0;i<30;i++){
    let sx=(i*137+50)%W,sy=(i*97+20)%(H-80);
    x.fillRect(sx,sy,1.5,1.5);
  }

  // ground
  x.fillStyle='#2d2d44';
  x.fillRect(0,H-40,W,40);
  x.fillStyle='#3d3d5c';
  for(let i=-1;i<W/24+1;i++){
    let gx=i*24-ground;
    x.fillRect(gx,H-40,12,4);
  }
  x.fillStyle='#22223a';
  x.fillRect(0,H-36,W,36);
  x.fillStyle='#2a2a42';
  x.fillRect(0,H-36,W,2);
}

function drawPipe(p){
  // top pipe
  let pg=x.createLinearGradient(p.x,0,p.x+PIPE_W,0);
  pg.addColorStop(0,'#e94560');pg.addColorStop(0.5,'#ff6b81');pg.addColorStop(1,'#e94560');
  x.fillStyle=pg;
  x.fillRect(p.x,0,PIPE_W,p.top);
  x.fillRect(p.x-3,p.top-18,PIPE_W+6,18);

  // bottom pipe
  x.fillStyle=pg;
  x.fillRect(p.x,p.bot,PIPE_W,H-40-p.bot);
  x.fillRect(p.x-3,p.bot,PIPE_W+6,18);

  // highlights
  x.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,0.1)';
  x.fillRect(p.x+4,0,4,p.top);
  x.fillRect(p.x+4,p.bot,4,H-40-p.bot);
}

function drawBird(){
  x.save();
  x.translate(bird.x,bird.y);
  x.rotate(bird.rot*Math.PI/180);

  // glow
  x.shadowColor='#e94560';x.shadowBlur=15;

  // body
  let bg=x.createRadialGradient(0,-2,2,0,0,bird.r);
  bg.addColorStop(0,'#ffdd57');bg.addColorStop(1,'#f0a500');
  x.fillStyle=bg;
  x.beginPath();x.arc(0,0,bird.r,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
  x.shadowBlur=0;

  // wing
  let wingY=Math.sin(Date.now()/60)*3;
  x.fillStyle='#e09200';
  x.beginPath();x.ellipse(-4,3+wingY,8,5,-.3,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();

  // eye
  x.fillStyle='#fff';
  x.beginPath();x.arc(5,-4,4,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();
  x.fillStyle='#1a1a2e';
  x.beginPath();x.arc(6.5,-4,2,0,Math.PI*2);x.fill();

  // beak
  x.fillStyle='#e94560';
  x.beginPath();x.moveTo(10,-1);x.lineTo(16,1);x.lineTo(10,3);x.closePath();x.fill();

  x.restore();
}

function drawScore(){
  x.textAlign='center';
  if(state==='play'||state==='dead'){
    x.font='bold 48px sans-serif';
    x.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.3)';
    x.fillText(score,W/2+2,72);
    x.fillStyle='#fff';
    x.fillText(score,W/2,70);
  }
}

function drawUI(){
  x.textAlign='center';
  if(state==='ready'){
    x.font='bold 28px sans-serif';
    x.fillStyle='#ffdd57';
    x.fillText('FLAPPY',W/2,H/2-40);
    x.font='16px sans-serif';

  }

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Flappy Bird</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            background-color: #222;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif;
            overflow: hidden;
            user-select: none;
        }
        canvas {
            background-color: #70c5ce;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            border-radius: 4px;
            display: block;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        // Game State
        let frames = 0;
        let score = 0;
        let gameState = 'START'; // START, PLAY, GAMEOVER

        // Constants
        const GRAVITY = 0.25;
        const JUMP = -4.6;
        const SPEED = 2;
        const GAP = 110;
        const GROUND_H = 20;

        // Entities
        const bird = {
            x: 50, y: 200, w: 24, h: 24, radius: 12, velocity: 0,
            draw: function() {
                ctx.save();
                ctx.translate(this.x + this.w/2, this.y + this.h/2);
                // Rotate based on velocity
                let rot = Math.min(Math.PI / 4, Math.max(-Math.PI / 4, (this.velocity * 0.1)));
                ctx.rotate(rot);
                
                // Body
                ctx.fillStyle = '#f1c40f';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(0, 0, this.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                
                // Eye
                ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(6, -4, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(8, -4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();
                
                // Beak
                ctx.fillStyle = '#e67e22';
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(8, 2);
                ctx.lineTo(16, 6);
                ctx.lineTo(8, 10);
                ctx.fill();
                
                ctx.restore();
            },
            update: function() {
                this.velocity += GRAVITY;
                this.y += this.velocity;

                // Floor Collision
                if (this.y + this.h >= canvas.height - GROUND_H) {
                    this.y = canvas.height - GROUND_H - this.h;
                    gameOver();
                }
                // Ceiling Collision
                if (this.y < 0) {
                    this.y = 0;
                    this.velocity = 0;
                }
            },
            jump: function() {
                this.velocity = JUMP;
            },
            reset: function() {
                this.y = 200;
                this.velocity = 0;
            }
        };

        const pipes = {
            items: [],
            w: 52,
            spawnRate: 130,
            draw: function() {
                for (let p of this.items) {
                    ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71'; // Pipe Green
                    // Top Pipe
                    ctx.fillRect(p.x, 0, this.w, p.top);
                    // Bottom Pipe
                    ctx.fillRect(p.x, canvas.height - p.bottom, this.w, p.bottom);
                    
                    // Borders
                    ctx.strokeStyle = '#27ae60';
                    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                    ctx.strokeRect(p.x, 0, this.w, p.top);
                    ctx.strokeRect(p.x, canvas.height - p.bottom, this.w, p.bottom);
                }
            },
            update: function() {
                if (frames % this.spawnRate === 0) {
                    // Calculate random heights
                    const minPipe = 40;
                    const maxTop = canvas.height - GROUND_H - GAP - minPipe;
                    const top = Math.floor(Math.random() * (maxTop - minPipe + 1) + minPipe);
                    const bottom = canvas.height - GROUND_H - GAP - top;
                    this.items.push({ x: canvas.width, top: top, bottom: bottom, passed: false });
                }

                for (let i = 0; i < this.items.length; i++) {
                    let p = this.items[i];
                    p.x -= SPEED;

                    // Collision Detection
                    // Horizontal overlap
                    if (bird.x + bird.w > p.x && bird.x < p.x + this.w) {
                        // Vertical overlap (Top pipe OR Bottom pipe)
                        if (bird.y < p.top || bird.y + bird.h > canvas.height - p.bottom) {
                            gameOver();
                        }
                    }

                    // Score update
                    if (p.x + this.w < bird.x && !p.passed) {
                        score++;
                        p.passed = true;
                    }

                    // Remove off-screen
                    if (p.x + this.w < 0) {
                        this.items.shift();
                        i--;
                    }
                }
            },
            reset: function() {
                this.items = [];
            }
        };

        const ground = {
            x: 0,
            draw: function() {
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ded895';
                ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - GROUND_H, canvas.width, GROUND_H);
                ctx.fillStyle = '#73bf2e';
                ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - GROUND_H, canvas.width, 4);
            }
        };

        // Input Handling
        function handleInput(e) {
            if (e.type === 'keydown' && e.code !== 'Space') return;
            if (e.type === 'touchstart') e.preventDefault();

            if (gameState === 'START') {
                gameState = 'PLAY';
                bird.jump();
            } else if (gameState === 'PLAY') {
                bird.jump();
            } else if (gameState === 'GAMEOVER') {
                resetGame();
            }
        }

        window.addEventListener('keydown', handleInput);
        canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', handleInput);
        canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', handleInput, {passive: false});

        // Game Logic
        function gameOver() {
            gameState = 'GAMEOVER';
        }

        function resetGame() {
            bird.reset();
            pipes.reset();
            score = 0;
            frames = 0;
            gameState = 'START';
        }

        function drawText(text, subtext) {
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'black';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;

            if (text) {
                ctx.font = 'bold 50px sans-serif';
                ctx.strokeText(text, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
                ctx.fillText(text, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
            }
            if (subtext) {
                ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                ctx.strokeText(subtext, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
                ctx.fillText(subtext, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
            }
        }

        // Main Loop
        function loop() {
            // Update
            if (gameState === 'PLAY') {
                bird.update();
                pipes.update();
                frames++;
            }

            // Draw
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
            
            // Background decoration (clouds)
            ctx.fillStyle = '#a2d9e8';
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(100, 80, 30, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(140, 80, 40, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(350, 120, 30, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();

            pipes.draw();
            ground.draw();
            bird.draw();

            // UI
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            if (gameState === 'PLAY' || gameState === 'GAMEOVER') {
                ctx.font = 'bold 40px sans-serif';
                ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
                ctx.strokeStyle = 'black';
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                ctx.strokeText(score, canvas.width / 2, 80);
                ctx.fillText(score, canvas.width / 2, 80);
            }

            if (gameState === 'START') {
                drawText("FLAPPY", "Tap or Space to Start");
            } else if (gameState === 'GAMEOVER') {
                drawText("GAME OVER", "Score: " + score + " - Tap to Restart");
            }

            requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }

        loop();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Flappy</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
body{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;min-height:100vh;background:#1a1a2e}
canvas{border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const c=document.getElementById('c'),x=c.getContext('2d'),W=c.width,H=c.height;
let bird, pipes, score, hi, state, vel;

const reset=()=>{
  bird={x:80,y:H/2,r:12};
  pipes=[];
  score=0;
  vel=0;
  state='play';
};

hi=localStorage.getItem('flappyHi')|0;

const jump=()=>{
  if(state==='play')vel=-7;
  else if(state==='over')reset();
};

c.onclick=jump;
document.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.code==='Space'){e.preventDefault();jump();}};

const spawn=()=>{
  const gap=150, h=~~(80+Math.random()*(H-gap-80));
  pipes.push({x:W,h,gap});
};

const update=()=>{
  if(state!=='play')return;
  vel+=.4;
  bird.y+=vel;
  if(bird.y<H-bird.r&&vel>0)bird.r=Math.min(bird.r+.2,14);
  else if(vel<0)bird.r=Math.max(bird.r-.3,10);
  if(bird.y<H-bird.r)bird.r=12;
  if(bird.y<bird.r||bird.y>H-bird.r){state='over';if(score>hi){hi=score;localStorage.setItem('flappyHi',hi);}}
  if(!pipes.length||W-pipes[pipes.length-1].x>200)spawn();
  pipes.forEach(p=>{
    p.x-=3;
    if(p.x<-60)p.gone=true;
    if(!p.scored&&p.x+60<bird.x){score++;p.scored=true;}
    if(bird.x+bird.r>p.x&&bird.x-bird.r<p.x+60&&(bird.y-bird.r<p.h||bird.y+bird.r>p.h+p.gap)){
      state='over';if(score>hi){hi=score;localStorage.setItem('flappyHi',hi);}
    }
  });
  pipes=pipes.filter(p=>!p.gone);
};

const draw=()=>{
  const g=x.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
  g.addColorStop(0,'#87CEEB');
  g.addColorStop(1,'#E0F6FF');
  x.fillStyle=g;
  x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  
  x.fillStyle='#5a3';
  x.fillRect(0,H-20,W,20);
  
  pipes.forEach(p=>{
    const g=x.createLinearGradient(p.x,0,p.x+60,0);
    g.addColorStop(0,'#2d5a27');
    g.addColorStop(1,'#4a8c3f');
    x.fillStyle=g;
    x.fillRect(p.x,0,60,p.h);
    x.fillRect(p.x,p.h+p.gap,60,H-p.h-p.gap);
    x.fillStyle='#1d3a17';
    x.fillRect(p.x+5,0,50,p.h);
    x.fillRect(p.x+5,p.h+p.gap,50,H-p.h-p.gap);
  });
  
  x.save();
  x.translate(bird.x,bird.y);
  x.rotate(Math.min(Math.max(vel*.05,-.5),.5));
  const bg=x.createRadialGradient(0,-2,0,0,0,bird.r);
  bg.addColorStop(0,'#ffeb3b');
  bg.addColorStop(1,'#f9a825');
  x.fillStyle=bg;
  x.beginPath();
  x.arc(0,0,bird.r,0,Math.PI*2);
  x.fill();
  x.fillStyle='#333';
  x.beginPath();
  x.arc(4,-3,3,0,Math.PI*2);
  x.fill();
  x.fillStyle='#fff';
  x.beginPath();
  x.arc(5,-4,1,0,Math.PI*2);
  x.fill();
  x.restore();
  
  x.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.3)';
  x.font='bold 32px monospace';
  x.textAlign='center';
  x.fillText(score,W/2,50);
  x.font='14px monospace';
  x.fillText('BEST: '+hi,W/2,75);
  
  if(state==='over'){
    x.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.5)';
    x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    x.fillStyle='#fff';
    x.font='bold 36px monospace';
    x.fillText('GAME OVER',W/2,H/2-30);
    x.font='20px monospace';
    x.fillText('Score: '+score,W/2,H/2+10);
    x.font='16px monospace';
    x.fillStyle='#aaa';
    x.fillText('Click or Space to restart',W/2,H/2+50);
  }
  
  if(state==='play'&&!pipes.length){
    x.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.5)';
    x.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    x.fillStyle='#fff';
    x.font='bold 24px monospace';
    x.fillText('Click or Space to start',W/2,H/2);
  }
};

const loop=()=>{update();draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop);};
reset();
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
